verdict.rationale: Ramp documents Funds as "a budget with restrictions" covering amount, interval, merchants, categories and countries, and says these spend controls, templates and approval workflows apply across cards, reimbursements and bills. Its marketing says it enforces spend limits before spend happens, issues cards for individual teams, and routes approvals by amount or team role. Spend requests also get a recommended action grounded in budgets. missing for 10: explicit project-level budget allocation, documentation of team/department budget rollups beyond team-scoped cards, independent or hands-on corroboration of enforcement.
